items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source systems. It was actively exploited in the wild before a hotfix was released.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this bulletin.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Exploitation attempts were observed in the wild shortly after disclosure.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including critical ones that could lead to unauthorized access, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. It includes fixes for CVE-2026-71362.

items.title: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Improper Encoding
items.summary: This RCE vulnerability in Adobe Commerce is caused by improper encoding, enabling arbitrary code execution without user interaction or authentication. It affects Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Unrestricted File Upload
items.summary: This RCE vulnerability in Adobe Commerce is caused by unrestricted file upload with dangerous types, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code by uploading malicious files. It requires user interaction.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. It includes fixes for CVE-2026-48358 and CVE-2026-48356.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass) in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
